request.style: English, South African isicathamiya, a cappella male choir telling a story, a deep bass narrator and the choir answering, clicks and stepping, building in intensity, 100 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They threw Daniel to the lions
And they sealed the stone
The king could not sleep all night
He fasted all alone

[Chorus]
My God sent his angel
And shut the lions' mouths
My God sent his angel
And they have not hurt me

[Verse]
At the break of day the king came running
Daniel, servant of the living God
Has your God been able to save you
Daniel answered from the den

[Chorus]
My God sent his angel
And shut the lions' mouths
My God sent his angel
And they have not hurt me

[Verse]
They lifted Daniel from the den
Not a wound was found on him
Because he trusted in his God
He came out without harm
